mentions.name: Editora
mentions.description: A keyboard-driven text editor for programmers with LSP support, debugging, Git and GitHub integration, multiple cursors, customizable keymaps, and live previews for Markdown, PDFs, and diagrams. It runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux with no accounts or telemetry, and is currently in beta as a hobby project.
